statements.status_notes: libcurl could use memory after it was freed while cleaning up HTTP/2 server push transfers when the parent handle shares connections with other handles through a share object. Upstream fixed it in curl 8.22.0 with https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/90325ff0444cbdff368bda5d26d6405a0bb6ee43, which makes server push transfers inherit the parent's share; see https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-18924.html (affected 7.44.0 to 8.21.0). Alpine lists the CVE as fixed in curl 8.22.0-r0 (aports main/curl secfixes). The DHI Alpine 3.23 curl packages are built with HTTP/2 support (nghttp2), so the code is present. Inspected libcurl.so and libcurl.a in every published build on x86_64 and aarch64 (8.17.0-r1 to 8.23.0-r1): the version string in libcurl matches the package version, and the HTTP/2 object in libcurl.a calls Curl_share_easy_link, the call the fix adds, in 8.22.0-r0 and later builds and not in any earlier build.
